name: Gyan Kashyap
intro: I'm a student developer learning through vibe-coding and building projects. I build for the love of games and the curiosity to turn my ideas into something real — from useful everyday tools to experiments with AI.
now: Right now, I'm learning AI/ML, experimenting with language models and neural networks, building tools for macOS, and exploring game development and interactive web interfaces.

journey.title: Learning by building
journey.detail: I’m a student developer exploring code through hands-on projects and AI-assisted development. Each project gives me something new to learn.

journey.title: Tools for everyday focus
journey.detail: Lunar Focus, Habit OS, Prompt Lib, and Timer App explore different ways to support focus, organize ideas, and build useful personal tools.

journey.title: Games and interactive experiments
journey.detail: AirBound and Neon Snake explore browser gameplay. Limitless takes that curiosity into gesture control, AR techniques, and interactive effects.

journey.title: Exploring AI and language models
journey.detail: Aizen explores a Transformer, tokenizer, training, and evaluation in PyTorch. AI Chatbot explores conversational interfaces through JARVIS and FRIDAY.

journey.title: What comes next
journey.detail: Keep learning AI/ML, building macOS tools, creating games, and trying new ideas for the web.

achievements.title: Built Aizen, a language model from scratch
achievements.detail: A decoder-only Transformer in PyTorch with a custom BPE tokenizer, training loops, an evaluation harness, and a web interface. The repository documents a 40M-parameter model and a benchmark progression from 17% to 60.75%.

achievements.title: Created a personal macOS study timer
achievements.detail: Timer App brings together study sessions, local history, analysis, and sticky notes in a private desktop app.

achievements.title: Built games and interactive experiments
achievements.detail: AirBound, Neon Snake, and Limitless turn an interest in games into projects spanning browser gameplay and gesture-driven effects.

achievements.title: Explored conversational AI interfaces
achievements.detail: AI Chatbot brings JARVIS and FRIDAY into a React interface with 3D avatars, conversation, and project-work panels.
